title: Access management

hostName.label: Local display name
hostName.note: Used for clients and the network; visible after others refresh. Pairings and permissions stay unchanged

interop.invitationNameNote: Batch label, e.g. “Project team”, not a client name
interop.inviteNote: Sets up the network automatically. Multiple clients can join within 24 hours, each as a separate member without permissions. Send privately
interop.connectNote: Paste and confirm to join automatically. Resource access requires separate permission
interop.confirmConnectionMessage: Pair with “{{name}}” and join “{{network}}” using the invitation's private credentials. Resource access requires separate permission
interop.switchNetworkMessage: Pair with “{{name}}” and switch from “{{currentNetwork}}” to “{{network}}” using the invitation's private credentials. Connections may be interrupted; resource permissions stay unchanged
interop.alreadyPairedMessage: Already paired with “{{name}}”; only this device's name will be saved. Network, pairing and permissions stay unchanged
interop.stopInvitationNote: Stopping “{{name}}” invalidates the code. Paired clients and permissions stay unchanged
interop.invitationNote: Private network credentials; valid for multiple clients for 24 hours. Shown once: save and send privately. Stopping does not rotate the network key. Refresh the list after clients join
interop.copyFailed: Copy failed; copy the code manually
interop.pairingNote: Pairing grants no access. Authorize members or roles in My shares
interop.disconnectNote: Unpair “{{name}}” locally and disable its local member; keep roles and grants
interop.noClients: Connect a client to see granted capabilities
interop.jsonNote: For complex arguments, enter a JSON object matching the schema. The provider validates it
interop.argumentsInvalid: Check the JSON object, numbers and required fields
interop.unknownNote: May have run. Do not resend; check only the original call. No call ID? Contact the provider
interop.agentNote: Delegates this Agent's existing tool permissions; native approvals still apply. Each call creates a session kept by the provider

folder.name: Share name
folder.nameLimit: Use at most 40 characters and 128 bytes
folder.note: Selected folder only; text size limits apply. Write access is optional

ownerOnly: Only the owner has access initially
otherGrantsRemain: Other roles or direct grants may still provide access
unshareMessage: Unregister “{{name}}” and remove all its grants; keep the local capability. Registering again requires new grants. Started operations will not be rolled back
pauseMessage: Pausing “{{name}}” blocks access for all remote members
disableMessage: Block “{{name}}” immediately; keep roles and grants

empty.available: No granted capabilities. Contact the provider for access

errors.response-too-large: Result too large to display fully. Narrow the request
errors.request-failed: Action rejected or failed. Check the current state
errors.unauthorized: Identity verification failed. Refresh and retry
errors.forbidden: You lack permission for this action
errors.outcome-unknown: Result unconfirmed. Refresh to verify; do not resubmit
errors.security-blocked: Cannot enable: network component lacks required port isolation
errors.start-failed: Network start failed. Check configuration and component
errors.stop-failed: Stop failed. Refresh to verify network state
errors.storage-unavailable: Save failed. Check local storage and retry
errors.network-change-required: Different network. Confirm the switch to join
errors.busy: Too many requests. Try again shortly
errors.invitation-expired: Invitation invalid or full. Ask for a new one

network.title: Network settings
network.scope: Invitations set up the network automatically. Resource access requires separate permission
network.name: Network name
network.peersNote: One TCP/UDP/WS/WSS/QUIC/WG URI per line; supports public nodes and WS/WSS paths
network.secretUnchanged: Configured; leave blank to keep it
network.listenersNote: One TCP/UDP/WS/WSS/QUIC/WG URI per line using a local IP:port; blank means outbound only
network.stunServersNote: One host:port per line, no protocol; e.g. stun.example:3478, [2001:db8::1]:3478
network.stunRequired: Enter at least one server or select Disabled
network.listLimit: Up to 32 lines, {{maxLength}} characters per line
network.foreignNetworkRelay: Let other networks relay through this device
network.foreignNetworkRelayNote: Traffic relay only, no access to local resources
network.relayNetworkWhitelistNote: Separate names with spaces; * allows all, blank blocks relaying
network.stopMessage: Stopping disconnects this node from the other nodes
